# Python API

```python
from ntpstats import load, load_one
from ntpstats.stability import series_stability
from ntpstats.analysis import summary, compare

s = load_one("/var/log/chrony/measurements.log", peer="192.0.2.10")
print(summary(s)["range_90"])
for r in series_stability(s, kinds=("oadev", "tdev"), ci=0.95):
    print(r.kind, r.taus, r.dev, r.lo, r.hi, r.alpha)
```

A [`TimeSeries`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/series/) has `t` (POSIX seconds), `offset` (seconds, reference − local),
`extra` (per-sample columns such as `delay`) and `meta`.

| Module | Contents |
|---|---|
| [`ntpstats.series`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/series/) | `TimeSeries` |
| [`ntpstats.parsers`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/parsers/) | `load`, `load_one`, per-format parsers |
| [`ntpstats.stability`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/stability/) | estimators, confidence intervals, noise ID, dynamic |
| [`ntpstats.edf`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/edf/) | equivalent degrees of freedom |
| [`ntpstats.analysis`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/analysis/) | summary, detrending, outliers, `compare` |
| [`ntpstats.network`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/network/) | delay floor, wedge, FPP, min-delay filter |
| [`ntpstats.filters`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/filters/) | Kalman filter and RTS smoother |
| [`ntpstats.estimators`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/estimators/) | estimator API and reference algorithms |
| [`ntpstats.simulate`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/simulate/) | clocks, paths, scenarios with ground truth |
| [`ntpstats.bench`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/bench/) | benchmark runner |
| [`ntpstats.sntp`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/sntp/), [`ntpstats.nts`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/nts/) | measurement clients (NTPv4, RFC 9769 interleaved, NTPv5, NTS, NTS pools) |
| [`ntpstats.roughtime`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/roughtime/) | Roughtime client, chained measurements, malfeasance reports |
| [`ntpstats.masks`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/masks/), [`ntpstats.report`](https://thiagodefreitas.github.io/NetworkTime/api/report/) | masks, HTML reports |
